purpose: Explicit, audited identity corrections to Stage-A control ids. Evidence values are never edited; only the id a reading is filed under, and every correction is recorded in the ledger row's context.

corrections.reason: The dropdown at the top of the LFO panel showing 'Chaos: Lorenz' is the LFO shape selector. The Atlas defines lfo1.shape as the shape control and lfo1.mode as Free/Retrig/Envelope.
The FREE / RETRIG / ENVELOPE selector is the LFO trigger mode, which the Atlas names lfo1.mode; lfo1.trigger is not an Atlas control.
corrections.atlas_check: lfo1.trigger is UNRESOLVED; lfo1.mode enum = Free/Retrig/Envelope
